instruction: User login with valid credentials on TaskFlow
input:
URL: https://taskflow-app.vercel.app/page User is logged in DOM Structure:
Forgot Password?
Test Intent: Verify login functionality works correctly
output:
# Fill email
page.locator('#email-input').fill('user@example.com')

# Fill password
page.locator('#password-input').fill('Secret123!')

# Submit form
page.locator('#submit-btn').click()

try:
    page.wait_for_url('**/dashboard', timeout=5000)
    assert 'dashboard' in page.url
except Exception as e:
    console_errors.append(f'Login failed: ' + str(e))
    raise
